El cierre del mes en un solo documento:: The month-end close in a single document: results, balance sheet, cash, indicators, business lines and comments.
Es el <b>cierre del mes en un solo docum: It is the month-end close in a single document: what management needs to see every month without opening five reports. It brings together results against the budget, balance sheet, cash, indicators that need attention, business lines and the team’s comments, with an AI-written summary at the top.

The cash position and the focus of the month.

Se elige la empresa, el escenario y el <: Choose the company, the scenario and the closing month (the list shows the months with results, the most recent first). There is no range: it is a single month. You can also choose the report’s color palette.
Tres líneas: resultado, caja y balance,: Three lines: result, cash and balance sheet, and focus of the month.
Ingresos, EBITDA y utilidad neta del mes: Revenue, EBITDA and net profit of the month against the budget and last year, and the year to date.
Activo total, capital de trabajo, razón: Total assets, working capital, current ratio and leverage, against last year’s close, and whether the balance sheet balances.
Caja inicial, flujo neto del mes contra: Opening cash, net flow of the month against the budget, operating free cash flow, closing cash and whether it reconciles with the balance sheet.
Cuántos indicadores hay en cada color de: How many indicators there are in each traffic-light color and the most serious reds and oranges.

Este informe <b>no calcula nada propio</: This report does not calculate anything of its own: it uses exactly the same calculations as each report, applied to a single month. That is why a figure here matches the one on the original screen. Everything comes from the model tables, so there is data only after the models have been run.
Cada sección es independiente: si una no: Each section is independent: if one has no data (for example the company does not use business lines), it appears as “no data” and the others are shown normally.
Los resultados se comparan contra el <b>: Results are compared against the budget and last year; the balance sheet against last year’s close.
<b>Verde y rojo</b> en las variaciones:: Green and red in the variances: green when the change is favorable (more revenue, more profit, less leverage) and red when it is unfavorable.
<b>Acumulado del año</b>: lo que va del: Year to date: what has accumulated in the year up to the closing month, against the accumulated budget.
<b>Caja final cuadra con el balance</b>:: Closing cash matches the balance sheet: the month’s flow explains the change in the balance sheet cash. If it does not match, check the January loads or the cash items of previous months.

New comments written here are saved as “Monthly management report”. All users of the company can write and read them; only the author or an administrator can edit or delete them. The comments are included in the PDF and the Excel file.
